image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a baby bib lying flat on a white textured surface. The bib features a green and olive horizontal stripe pattern with a bright pink trim around the neck hole and the outer edge. It has two raised, rubberized appliques in the center: a light blue elephant-like character on the left and a pink hippo-like character on the right.

The facial features of the blue character are indistinct and asymmetrical. The eye/ear region blends into the head shape without clear definition, suggesting a minor generation failure in rendering small detailed objects.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The horizontal stripes warp slightly inconsistently around the neck hole curvature, appearing more like a texture map projection error than natural fabric folding.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'blue elephant' and 'pink hippo' figures. AI generators often struggle with small, distinct graphical elements on patterns. Check if the characters look like they are physically attached to the bib or if they bleed into the background. Also, verify if the stripe pattern remains logically continuous behind the characters or if it distorts unnaturally.
